question.text: The equation of the tangent to the conic $x^2-y^2-8 x+2 y+11=0$ at $(2,1)$ is

solution.text:
Hints : Equation of tangent at $\left(x_1, y_1\right)$ is
$$
\begin{aligned}
& x x_1-y y_1-4\left(x+x_1\right)+\left(y+y_1\right)+11=0 \\
& x_1=2 ; y=1
\end{aligned}
$$
$\therefore$ Equation of tangent is
$$
\begin{aligned}
& 2 x-y-4(x+2)+(y+1)+11=0 \\
& \text { or } \quad-2 x-8+12=0
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{ll}
\text { or } & -2 x+4=0 \\
\text { or } & 2 x=4 \\
\text { or } & x=2 \\
\text { or } & x-2=0
\end{array}
$$
